sentences.en: Our school prohibits us from going to the movies alone.
sentences.zh: 我们学校禁止我们单独去看电影。

sentences.en: A radical disarmament treaty prohibits all armaments and armed forces.
sentences.zh: 一项激进的裁军条约禁止所有武器和武装力量。

sentences.en: The government prohibits us from carrying guns without a license.
sentences.zh: 政府禁止我们在没有执照的情况下携带枪支。
